| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `gainFocus()` | Calls a focus gained event if the client does not currently have focus This behaves as if you were to click the icon in your task bar, no separate events needed. |
| `getAccountIdentifier()` | Gets a more broadly determined identifier for an account. |
| `getBase()` | Returns the region's base tile (Uses getBaseX() and getBaseY() ) to position tile. |
| `getBaseX()` | Returns the region's base x |
| `getBaseY()` | Returns the region's base y |
| `getCanvas()` | Gets the RS canvas |
| `getCollisionMaps()` | Gets all collision maps |
| `getDestination()` | Gets the tile of your destination |
| `getDestX()` | Gets the destination X |
| `getDestY()` | Gets the destination Y |
| `getEntities()` | Gets all NPC s, Player s, and GameObject |
| `getFPS()` | Gets the FPS limit set by the client, or 50 FPS if it's not active |
| `getGameCycle()` | Gets the game cycle |
| `getGameState()` | Gets the current game state |
| `getGameStateId()` | Gets the current game state ID. |
| `getGameStateID()` | Deprecated. |
| `getGameTick()` | Gets the current game tick, which increases roughly every 600ms |
| `getHost()` | Deprecated. |
| `getIdleLogout()` | Gets the current idle timeout in cycles 1 cycle = 20ms |
| `getIdleTime()` | Gets idle time |
| `getInstance()` | Gets the bot instance |
| `getLoginIndex()` | Gets the login index |
| `getMapAngle()` | Gets map rotation |
| `getMessageContainers()` | Deprecated. |
| `getMyPlayerIndex()` | Gets your local player's index |
| `getOnGameThread(java.util.function.Supplier<T> supplier)` | Runs the supplier provided on the RS game thread, used when logic is required to be on the game thread. |
| `getPassword()` | Returns the player's password |
| `getPlane()` | Gets your current plane |
| `getTileHeights()` | Gets tile heights |
| `getTileSettings()` | Gets tile settings |
| `getUsername()` | Deprecated. username/email will be gone when legacy accounts are retired |
| `getViewport()` | Returns the current viewport |
| `getViewportTools()` | Returns viewport tool. |
| `hasFocus()` | Returns if the RS client currently has focus |
| `hasMembersAccess()` | Checks if you currently have access to members features in OSRS |
| `isCameraInMotion()` | Checks if the camera is in motion |
| `isDynamicRegion()` | Shows if you are in a dynamic/instanced region |
| `isGroupIronman()` | Checks if the current character is a group ironman |
| `isInCutscene()` | Checks if an in game cutscene is active |
| `isIronman()` | Checks if the current character is any non-group ironman |
| `isLoggedIn()` | Checks if you're logged in or otherwise in the game |
| `isUltimateIronman()` | Checks if the current character is an ultimate ironman |
| `isWorldSelectorOpen()` | Checks if the world selector is open |
| `loseFocus()` | Sends a focus lost event if the client currently has focus This sends no other events, losing focus by mouse would suggest moving mouse off canvas and then losing focus Losing focus by keyboard would expect the alt key to be pressed at least (for alt+tab) |
| `runOnGameThread(java.lang.Runnable runnable)` | Adds a runnable to the client thread execution list. |
| `runOnGameThread(java.lang.Runnable... runnables)` | Adds multiple runnables to the client thread execution list so they all fire on the next cycle This will *not* wait for the client thread to process these runnables. |
| `runOnGameThreadAndWait(java.lang.Runnable... runnables)` | Adds multiple runnables to the client thread execution list so they all fire on the next cycle. |
| `seededRandom()` | Returns a random number seeded by account name between .9 and 1.1 |
| `setCameraInMotion(boolean cameraInMotion)` | Sets the camera in motion |
| `setIdleLogout(int cycles)` | Sets the in game idle cycle count before being logged out |
| `setMenuIgnoreEntities(boolean ignore)` | Separate, forced setting for ignoring entities when building menu, ignores all but "Walk here" actions This does NOT get reset on its own. |
| `setViewport(Viewport viewport)` | Sets the viewport |
